summary: Backend-only testing for Aida Health MVP. Created pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/test_aida_backend.py with 16 tests across 10 classes covering: root/seed idempotency, profiles CRUD, analytics readiness, gamification, puzzle config get/save, symptoms CRUD, medications CRUD (incl. PUT), labs manual CRUD, AI chat with Gemini 3 Flash (persistence verified), doctor report (with ai_summary), and labs/upload multipart OCR endpoint. All 16 tests PASSED against the public EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. Gemini 3 Flash integration is functional for /api/chat, /api/report, and /api/labs/upload.

minor.issue: Uses deprecated FastAPI @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown'); should migrate to lifespan context manager (server.py:760, 771).

Idempotency check uses count>0, so seed also becomes no-op if profiles were created via POST /api/profiles rather than seeded. Acceptable for MVP but note that /api/seed can never re-seed after any profile exists.
Returns default widgets object without profile existence validation (harmless but inconsistent with other endpoints that 404).

action_items: Optional: migrate FastAPI startup/shutdown hooks to lifespan API to remove deprecation warnings.
Optional: consider validating profile_id existence in GET /api/puzzle/{profile_id} for consistency.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is a single 774-line file; consider splitting into routers (profiles, labs, chat, gamification) if it grows further.
clean() helper is defined but unused since all queries already exclude _id via projection {'_id': 0} - good practice, but dead code can be removed.

AI error handling in /api/chat correctly persists the user message before calling Gemini; but if Gemini fails, the orphan user message remains in DB. Consider cleanup or a placeholder assistant message on failure.

labs/upload writes a temp file and unlinks in the exception path but if HTTPException is raised before os.unlink at line 335, cleanup is OK. However, temp file cleanup is duplicated - use try/finally.
All endpoints correctly use env vars (MONGO_URL, DB_NAME, EMERGENT_LLM_KEY), exclude ObjectId _id, use async motor properly, and return Pydantic-validated responses.
seed_data_creation: Relied on /api/seed endpoint (auto-runs on startup); test suite creates TEST_-prefixed profiles/symptoms/meds/labs and cleans them up after each test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend fully functional. Public URL: https://life-health-hub-1.preview.emergentagent.com. Auto-seed on startup creates 3 profiles (me/child/relative) with sample meds/symptoms/labs. Gemini 3 Flash via EMERGENT_LLM_KEY works for /api/chat, /api/report ai_summary, and /api/labs/upload (accepts 1x1 PNG and returns a valid LabTest). Pytest run: `pytest /app/backend/tests/ -v` (~13s, parallel via pytest-xdist).
